title: Code and results for "Aggressive feature reduction degrades the selective reliability and clinical net benefit of clinical risk models"

creators.name: El-Ghareeb, Haitham A.
creators.affiliation: Faculty of Computers and Information Sciences, Mansoura University

description: Research compendium for a pre-registered, leakage-safe audit of what aggressive feature reduction costs clinical risk models beyond discrimination: calibration, selective (risk-coverage) reliability, clinical net benefit, conformal informativeness and between-subgroup equity, across twelve public clinical datasets, three rankers, three learners, fractional budgets from 100% to 25%, and matched exact-k budgets. Includes the analysis library, the experiment drivers, the hash-pinned calibration configurations, the pre-registration with a dated addendum, the committed per-configuration result summaries, the out-of-fold caches from which the worked clinical examples are computed, and twenty-six enrichment experiments each with its own hash manifest and producing code. Negative results and pre-specifications are included and marked as such. Every reported number regenerates from committed code, a committed configuration and a recorded seed.
